input: I want to build an explainable RAG system for research question answering that follows citation networks and entity-relation paths across papers instead of retrieving isolated chunks.
evaluation_note: Unseen idea should connect citation-aware research QA to graph and multi-hop methods.

input: I want a graph-based RAG system that updates as new documents arrive, maintains updateable knowledge, and uses adaptive pruning to keep multi-hop retrieval efficient and low latency.
evaluation_note: Unseen idea should surface graph-maintenance and efficient-retrieval concerns.

input: I want to evaluate GraphRAG on multi-hop questions with inter-context conflicts, where different documents contain conflicting evidence, measuring faithfulness, context relevance, and answer accuracy.
evaluation_note: Unseen benchmark idea should connect conflict handling to graph-RAG evaluation and grounding metrics.

input: A new RAG method will synthesize scientific evidence distributed across long papers and use graph-indexed concepts, datasets, and limitations to recommend the next research direction.
evaluation_note: Unseen research-synthesis idea should connect document structure, provenance, and research-direction reasoning.
